en-US.author: XiaoYouChR
en-US.longDescription: A cross-platform fluent-design AI-boost multi-threaded downloader built with Python.
en-US.name: Ghost Downloader
en-US.releaseNotes:
Note
Following this release, updates will be less frequent due to my studies. Thank you for your understanding. Feedback is always welcome.
Buy me a coffee: Donate
New Features 🎉
- Trim clips from regular video links, not just YouTube and Bilibili (#1022) By @XiaoYouChR
- On Android, third-party browsers can hand downloads to Ghost Downloader (#1009, #804, #660) By @XiaoYouChR
- Support Bilibili b23.tv short links (#1025) By @XiaoYouChR
- The tray menu adds New Task and Settings (#1002) By @XiaoYouChR
- New option to switch to another port automatically when the browser extension port is in use (#1028) By @XiaoYouChR
Improvements 🔧
- A task's link can only be changed to a new link for the same file. Add a new task to download a different file By @XiaoYouChR
- Improved the English translation By @i0ntempest
Bug Fixes 🐛
- Fixed clip downloads of some long videos downloading the whole media instead (#1013) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed Bilibili links with av IDs failing to parse By @XiaoYouChR
GD4B Browser Extension Updates 🌐
- v2.3.1
- Connects to the desktop app automatically after it switches ports. Click the connection status in the header to pair or reconnect (#1028) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the browser's own save dialog still appearing when a download is taken over (#972) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed some taken-over downloads producing broken files because cookies were missing (#813) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the Add Task window being covered by the extension popup when it opens a second time By @XiaoYouChR
Feature Pack Updates 📦
- arxiv_pack 1.1.0, bili_pack 1.3.0, bittorrent_pack 1.2.0, ed2k_pack 2.1.0, ffmpeg_pack 1.2.0, ftp_pack 1.2.0, github_pack 1.2.0, http_pack 1.2.0, huggingface_pack 1.2.0, m3u8_pack 1.2.0, wrapped_link_pack 1.1.0, yt_dlp_pack 1.4.0, zip_pack 1.1.0: Updated with the changes above. Requires v4.5.0 By @XiaoYouChR
Note
此次更新后, 由于本人学业原因, 将放缓更新节奏, 敬请谅解. 欢迎继续提供反馈.
请我喝杯咖啡: 捐赠项目
新功能 🎉
- 普通视频直链也能截取片段, 不再限于 YouTube 和哔哩哔哩 (#1022) By @XiaoYouChR
- Android 端支持第三方浏览器调用 Ghost Downloader 下载 (#1009, #804, #660) By @XiaoYouChR
- 支持哔哩哔哩 b23.tv 短链 (#1025) By @XiaoYouChR
- 托盘菜单新增"新建任务"和"设置" (#1002) By @XiaoYouChR
- 新增浏览器扩展端口被占用时自动切换端口的选项 (#1028) By @XiaoYouChR
功能优化 🔧
- 更换任务链接时只能换成同一文件的新链接, 下载其他文件请添加新任务 By @XiaoYouChR
- 改进英文翻译 By @i0ntempest
问题修复 🐛
- 修复部分长视频截取片段时下载了完整媒体的问题 (#1013) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复哔哩哔哩 av 号链接无法解析的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
GD4B 浏览器扩展更新 🌐
- v2.3.1
- 桌面端切换端口后自动重新连接, 点击顶栏的连接状态可直接配对或重连 (#1028) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复接管下载时仍弹出浏览器原生保存框的问题 (#972) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复部分接管的下载因缺少 Cookie 导致文件损坏的问题 (#813) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复"添加任务"窗口第二次弹出时被扩展窗口挡住的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
功能包更新 📦
- arxiv_pack 1.1.0, bili_pack 1.3.0, bittorrent_pack 1.2.0, ed2k_pack 2.1.0, ffmpeg_pack 1.2.0, ftp_pack 1.2.0, github_pack 1.2.0, http_pack 1.2.0, huggingface_pack 1.2.0, m3u8_pack 1.2.0, wrapped_link_pack 1.1.0, yt_dlp_pack 1.4.0, zip_pack 1.1.0: 随上述改动更新. 需要 v4.5.0 By @XiaoYouChR
